style: STYLE RULES: Hand-made pixel art in exactly the style of the reference image(s): crisp square pixels on a strict grid (each art pixel is one solid square block of image pixels), no anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft gradients between blocks, no noisy dithering. Warm natural palette, soft painterly shading with light from the upper left. NO OUTLINES: never draw black, dark-brown or dark contour lines around the subjects or around their parts; shapes are defined only by their colors, light and shadow, and where an edge needs separation use just a slightly darker shade of that area's own color. The reference images show the palette, pixel size and scale only (ignore their dark outlines): draw new subjects, do not copy or edit the reference. BACKGROUND: one flat solid magenta color (#FF00FF) everywhere around the subjects, with no shadows, ground, grass, scenery, glow or texture on it. Leave clear magenta space between separate subjects. No text, letters, numbers, labels, borders or frames.
